'''Wilder Thistlenettle''' is a [[dwarf]] [[quest giver]] located in a nearly empty pub in the [[Dwarven District]] of [[Stormwind City]]. He and his brother were members of a mining company until they were caught in a cave-in within the [[Deadmines]]. Though Wilder escaped, the rest of the company was killed, and they now roam the collapsed tunnel as restless [[undead]].
